_source: Transcribed from the Claude Design handoff bundle's CATS constant in Curia.dc.html (fetched 2026-07-30) — the real onboarding tile catalog for Do/Drink/Eat, originally 15 tiles per category. Sub-preferences (`subPreferences`) default ON per CLAUDE.md Hard rule 2; this file lists the possible set only, not any user's on/off state. One entry ('Cafés (late)') has had the source file's mangled UTF-8 encoding (rendered as 'CafÃ©s') corrected back to a plain é.
_neighbourhoodFavouriteSource: 'Neighbourhood favourite' added to Eat 2026-09-03 (16th Eat tile, catalog no longer 15/15/15 by design, not an oversight) at explicit user direction after a full catalog review: 'we aren't doing cuisine by country as a category option as its overdone... people want to know the atmosphere or moment that a place is known for, not what kind of food.' Closes the largest real gap the review found — 7 venues (Happy Seasons, Rudy's, Vietbowl, Delhi Dream, Phanthong Thai, The Stolen Lamb, Waugh Brow Farm Shop) sharing a real, distinct, unpretentious/no-fuss/long-established mood that no existing tile captured — see src/lib/scoring/tile-catalog-map.ts's own note on this tile for the per-venue reasoning. Deliberately a mood, not a cuisine list, matching that direction exactly.
_regionSource: `region` added to every Drink tile 2026-09, at explicit user request, onboarding Riyadh — see HomeRegion's own doc comment (src/types/models.ts) for the full architecture. Alcohol is prohibited nationwide in Saudi Arabia, so the original 15 Drink tiles (all built around cocktail bars/wine bars/pubs/nightclubs) have zero real applicability there; tagged `region: 'uk'` rather than left untagged so a Riyadh member never sees them during onboarding. Eight new Drink tiles added alongside them, tagged `region: 'riyadh'`, built from real, verified categories (WebSearch, 2026-09) rather than invented: Specialty coffee (Saudi's specialty-coffee scene is genuinely large — 60,000+ licensed cafes, described as rivaling Melbourne/Tokyo for density), Mocktail lounges (the real non-alcoholic equivalent of a cocktail bar — e.g. the Four Seasons Riyadh's Tonic Bar), Tea houses (traditional karak/spiced tea culture, majlis-style seating), Shisha lounges (a genuine, distinct social-evening category, not a novelty), Dessert cafés and Juice & smoothie bars (both real and prominent in Saudi social life), Hotel lounges (the non-alcoholic parallel to 'Hotel bars' — live pianist, five-star setting, no alcohol served), and Rooftop cafés (kept as a distinct name from 'Rooftop & scenic' specifically to avoid any ambiguity about whether a rooftop venue implies alcohol — it doesn't, but the existing UK tile's name and 'DJ sets' framing read as bar culture, so a clean separate entry was safer than assuming). Do/Eat/Holiday tiles are untouched and stay universal (no `region` field) — this is deliberately narrow to the one category that's actually incompatible across the two markets, not a wholesale re-tagging.
_playSportSource: 'Play sport' added 2026-09-18 at explicit user request ('lets add play sport, with refinements of golf, padel and tennis') — a genuinely distinct tile from the existing 'Spectator sport' (watching a match vs. playing one yourself). Wired to the real GOLF CLUB venue type (22 real Cheshire clubs as of tonight — see venues.json's own _cheshireGolfClubsSource note) via tile-catalog-map.ts. Padel and Tennis have zero real venues anywhere in the dataset right now — left as real sub-preference options rather than removed, same precedent as 'Wine tasting'/'Boat trips' under Holiday (thin but real, not padded), but honestly a placeholder until real padel/tennis venues get added; picking either currently narrows a member to nothing. Building this tile also surfaced something bigger, worth its own note rather than being buried here: NO venue anywhere in the whole 334-venue dataset has ever had sub_preference_tags populated — every tile's sub-preference toggle (the onboarding screen's 'refine within this tile' step) has been completely inert this whole project, the same class of bug as the distinctiveness/ownership mapping fix from earlier tonight, just never caught because nothing before this tile depended on it working. Fixed here only for GOLF CLUB venues (tagged 'Golf', supabase/migrations/0020_play_sport_tile.sql) so this specific tile actually functions — the other 21 tiles' sub-preferences remaining inert across the other 300+ venues is real, separate, larger scope, not done here.
_holidaySource: Added 2026-09 at explicit user request, for the Santorini pass — see TileCategory's own doc comment in src/types/models.ts and src/lib/scoring/tile-catalog-map.ts's note on the 'Beach clubs' tile. Started as one tile, sized to match real curated venues rather than invented speculatively. Expanded to four 2026-09, at explicit user request ('expand the preferences beyond just beach club'): 'Sunset bars' (4 real venues — Sun Spirit, Sparkling Sunset Oia, Lioyerma, Astra Suites/Buddha-Bar), 'Wine tasting' and 'Boat trips' (1 real venue each — Domaine Sigalas; Sunset Oia Sailing Cruises). The latter two are thin by this file's usual bar, but real and genuinely distinct from every other Holiday/Drink/Do tile — same precedent as 'Champagne bars' (a single real venue, Bacchus, when it was first added) elsewhere in this catalog; not padded with invented venues to look fuller.
_tileSimplificationSource: 2026-09-18, at explicit user request following the Play sport build: 'i want to simplify the tiles and their refinement options, as i find a lot of them to be too detailed for our current database... these refinements should be a real value added, not unnecessary fluff... i also want to make it more normal... golf and padel and yoga and cinema and museums and art galleries are great go do activities, we dont need to overcomplicate it with botanical gardens etc.' Audited every tile against real live venue counts (docs/data/venues.json cross-referenced with tile-catalog-map.ts's slug mapping) before deciding anything — the finding was worse than 'too many refinements for the size': sub_preference_tags has never been populated at scale anywhere (see _playSportSource above), so every refinement except Golf's was already 100% cosmetic regardless of tile size. Two changes made together: (1) cut 17 tiles outright that had 0-1 real matching venues, including 6 in Eat alone (Romantic, Business lunch, Al fresco, Private dining, Wine-led dining, Chef's counter) that showed zero real results no matter what a member picked; Theatre and Ballet & opera merged into one tile since they mapped to the exact same 8 venues with zero real differentiation; Beer gardens and Whisky & spirits folded into Upmarket pubs and Cocktail bars respectively (their single venues stay reachable via the surviving tile — see tile-catalog-map.ts). (2) emptied subPreferences on every remaining tile except three genuinely backed by real, structurally-distinct venue subsets: Markets (Artisan stalls/Food markets map onto the real artisan-market/market-hall type split), Cocktail bars (Speakeasy-style maps onto the real 3-venue speakeasy subset), and Play sport (kept in full at explicit user request — 'we should keep padel and tennis but we should source some venues' — sourcing in progress, see venues.json for whatever's landed by the time this is read). Markets and Cocktail bars' surviving refinements are backed by a real migration (supabase/migrations/0022_tile_simplification.sql) tagging the actual venues, not left cosmetic like everything before them. Middle East (Riyadh) Drink tiles and Holiday deliberately left untouched — smaller, separate catalogs the user didn't call out, worth their own pass rather than folding in here. Do went 16→11 tiles (46→5 refinements), UK Drink 15→10 (53→2), Eat 16→9 (43→0). Full before/after tile-by-tile reasoning was given directly to the user in chat before this was built, not re-derived here.
